rows.title: Canonical-skill migration
rows.requirement: Canonical skill strictly requires manual handoff, deleting team wrapper, and matching docs.

rows.title: Manual Antigravity boundary
rows.requirement: Manual Antigravity handoff uses Gemini as the initial lead planner; Gemini receives the exact-base planning requirements and research and produces the uncommitted implementation plan and sibling manifest. Gemini must not be represented or invoked as a Pi provider/model; implementation, review, publication, and merge authority remain separate, with no automatic lifecycle authority.

rows.title: Exact-base worktree provisioning
rows.requirement: Exact-base worktree provisioning is verified and bounded by delivery-worktree.mjs.

rows.title: Deterministic validator contract
rows.requirement: Validator ensures strict input, path, and security bounds, and performs no mutations.

rows.title: Manifest v2 contract
rows.requirement: Implement implementation-plan-manifest/v2 with exporter and generated schema in contracts/.

rows.title: Exact schema parity
rows.requirement: Exact runtime and generated-schema parity verification passes.

rows.title: V1 Backward compatibility
rows.requirement: Preserve read/validation for existing v1 plans; no silent rewrites.

rows.title: Epic metadata in v2 manifest
rows.requirement: V2 manifest carries hard dependencies, predecessor outputs, and portfolio metadata.

rows.title: Explicit staleness boundaries
rows.requirement: Defines explicit drift triggers without claiming descendant-base campaign staleness.

rows.title: Digest and ID parity
rows.requirement: Digest and acceptance IDs match exactly between plan and manifest over UTF-8 bytes.

rows.title: Audit corpus tests
rows.requirement: AIDEV-132–AIDEV-140 audit corpus tests verify detections via independent classes.

rows.title: Exact negative tests
rows.requirement: Independent tests cover JSON faults, bounds, traversal, Git refs, base-drifts, and ID mismatches.

rows.title: Review discipline
rows.requirement: Classifies defects vs preferences, bounding revisions and adversarial paths.

rows.title: V1-to-V2 Bootstrap boundary
rows.requirement: Ensures AIDEV-182 emits valid v1 artifacts until v2 merges.

rows.title: Rollback verification
rows.requirement: Tests rollback restoring previous skill versions without auto-publication.

rows.title: Bounded two-stage protocol
rows.requirement: Bounded two-stage protocol explicitly enforces Stage 1 vs Stage 2 boundaries and exact state progression.

rows.title: Trusted model selection
rows.requirement: Trusted model/policy selection correctly defines operator-owned choices and lifecycle authority boundaries.

rows.title: Validator accuracy
rows.requirement: Validator accurately enforces constraints against malformed inputs, missing objects, bounded resources, Windows/Linux handling, and stateless behavior.

rows.title: Ownership mapping
rows.requirement: Evaluates ownership constraints for evidence owner, fixture owner, acceptance owner, and repository-document authority.

rows.title: Independent plan approval
rows.requirement: Requires independent plan approval before implementation.

rows.title: Implementation slices
rows.requirement: Validates implementation slices (1, 2, 3) merge according to explicit dependency boundaries.

rows.title: Deterministic observability
rows.requirement: Validates deterministic bounded observability (error codes and envelope outputs without prompt/credential leakage).

rows.title: Portfolio metadata revalidation
rows.requirement: V2 manifest correctly parses bounded portfolio metadata and validates just-in-time staleness revalidation inputs.
